productDecision.reason: No candidate completed an identical-workload real-runtime acceptance comparison this turn; product code stays untouched.

ecosystemRotation: agent-first Linux isolation; format-correct crash evidence; bounded failure diagnostics; deterministic replay

researchDelta.why: Sandlock directly targets AI-agent/untrusted processes with rootless Landlock+seccomp, deterministic time/randomness, COW, network/HTTP policy and a reported ~5 ms startup profile. It moves ahead of heavier isolation paths for the first Ferrum isolation differential, but only if all requested protections are proven active and never degraded/disabled.
researchDelta.crashPlan: ProcDump native core -> GDB/eu-stack/drgn; Crashpad .dmp -> rust-minidump. Never cross formats.

maximumImprovementChallenge.result: No additional product change justified before real proof. Sandlock is the strongest new experiment, not yet an adoption.

guardrails: No caps, reduced coverage/data/fidelity/tests/evidence or synthetic substitution.
Isolation must fail closed; degraded/disabled/fail-open protection cannot be silently accepted.
Native cores and minidumps remain format-correct authoritative artifacts; sanitized summaries are derived.
Tracing/replay supplements normal real-runtime acceptance only.
Checkpoint/restore requires exact build/runtime/environment identity and explicit invalidation.
